translations.web: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
translations.bsb: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
translations.kjv: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
translations.asv: and say, We piped unto you, and ye did not dance; we wailed, and ye did not mourn.
